title: Automated Detection of Myocardial Infarction and Heart Conduction Disorders Based on Feature Selection and a Deep Learning Model
summary: On single-label PTB-XL records, the reported overall accuracy was 99.20% using an internal record split. No independent cohort or patient-level validation is reported; this is database-internal classification, not clinical deployment.
ai_technology: A 14-layer CNN extracts ECG features that feed a multiclass SVM for five diagnostic superclasses.
